name: Identity and type registry
description: SuiteApp (the five apps and the launcher), bundle ids under one prefix (SuiteIdentity.prefix), and SuiteTypeRegistry: every document and pasteboard type each app reads and writes and the default app per type. Bundle/Info/*.plist mirror it; a test checks both. UniqueFileNames: the one unique-file-name rule every app's export uses ("Card.png", then "Card 2.png").
